issue.title: Modal no longer traps focus after upgrading to 1.4.0
issue.body:
### Environment

- @acme/ui: 1.4.0
- Vue: 3.5.13
- Nuxt: 3.14.0

### Description

Since upgrading from 1.3.2 to 1.4.0, pressing Tab inside an open `UModal` moves focus to the page behind it. On 1.3.2 focus stayed inside the modal. Downgrading to 1.3.2 makes the problem go away, nothing else changed in our app.

### Reproduction

https://github.com/annakim/acme-modal-focus-repro

### Expected behavior

Focus stays inside the modal while it is open, as it did in 1.3.2.
